dimensions.label: Search / retrieval trigger
dimensions.definition: When and why the surface decides to retrieve from the live web rather than answer from model weights.
dimensions.note: No validated claim for this surface covers this dimension. Unknown is a valid, explicit answer, not a missing value.

dimensions.label: Retrieval provider / index
dimensions.definition: Which index or upstream search provider backs retrieval.
dimensions.note: No validated claim for this surface covers this dimension. Unknown is a valid, explicit answer, not a missing value.

dimensions.label: Query rewrite / fan-out
dimensions.definition: Whether and how the user query is rewritten, decomposed or fanned out into multiple sub-queries.
dimensions.note: No validated claim for this surface covers this dimension. Unknown is a valid, explicit answer, not a missing value.

dimensions.label: Crawling and indexing controls
dimensions.definition: Crawler user-agents, robots directives and site-side controls that govern what is fetched and indexed.

dimensions.label: Freshness / recrawl

dimensions.note: No validated claim for this surface covers this dimension. Unknown is a valid, explicit answer, not a missing value.

dimensions.label: Candidate selection / reranking
